entry.title: MitoArc: A Reproducible Short-Read Workflow for Human Mitochondrial Genome Analysis with Circular-Coordinate and NUMT-Aware Evaluation
entry.summary:
Human mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) analysis from short-read sequencing is complicated by nuclear mitochondrial DNA segments (NUMTs), circular-reference coordinates, sequencing depth, and variant-caller configuration. We developed MitoArc, a Nextflow workflow that accepts paired-end FASTQ files or pre-aligned BAM and CRAM files, retains available nuclear mapping context, and performs standard and shifted-coordinate processing. It runs Genome Analysis Toolkit (GATK) Mutect2 and mutserve2 independently and reports mitochondrial quality metrics, NUMT evidence, haplogroups, contamination estimates, functional annotations, consensus sequences, and reproducibility outputs.

Source: bioRxiv Bioinformatics Preprints · Tags: #bioinformatics #genomics-proteins #consensus

entry.title: Isopolia: A Three-Tier Latency L1 Architecture for Autonomous AI Agents - Owned-Object FastPay (D4 Fencing), Day-1 X25519 + ML-KEM-768 Privacy, and Endogenous AMM Liquidation Bounds
entry.summary:
Overview: What We Are Building Isopolia is a sovereign Layer-1 protocol and deterministic execution stack built specifically for autonomous AI-agent economies (machine-to-machine micropayments via MCP / x402 / A2A, verifiable compute leasing, on-chain agent identity did:isop , and decentralized governance). Autonomous agents impose conflicting requirements on base-layer design: Sub-50 ms micropayments vs. shared-state safety : Tool calls and GPU streaming cannot wait for global BFT ordering, yet running a fast-path alongside BFT consensus without strict mutual exclusion creates cross-domain double-spend and state-divergence hazards.

Source: Ethereum Research (ethresear.ch) · Tags: #zkp #consensus #rust #post-quantum
